title: Fact sheet (content/facts.json)
$comment: GDD 'The fact sheet', ADR-0010 and ADR-0023. Checks a schema cannot express (unique ids, one sentence, a person as verifier) are in tools/validate_content.py.

id.$comment: Dotted lowercase segments, as in the GDD's example hooks.pretooluse.deny.
id.description: must be lowercase dotted segments such as hooks.pretooluse.deny

claim.$comment: One plain sentence on one line, ending with a full stop, question mark or exclamation mark. The validator also rejects a second sentence inside it.
claim.description: must be one sentence on one line, ending with '.', '?' or '!'

source.$comment: An https URL on an official Claude documentation host. The S3 host is allowed only under the one folder that serves the CCAR-F exam guide (ADR-0025). The host must be followed directly by a slash, so user info, ports and look-alike hosts fail.
source.description: must be an https URL on code.claude.com, platform.claude.com, docs.claude.com, docs.anthropic.com, support.claude.com or anthropic-partners.skilljar.com, or under Anthropic's exam-guide folder on everpath-course-content.s3-accelerate.amazonaws.com

verified.$comment: The date a person approved the entry (ADR-0023), as YYYY-MM-DD.

verifier.$comment: The person who approved the entry. A subagent never counts (ADR-0023); the validator rejects agent names.
verifier.description: must be a person's name without leading or trailing whitespace

terms.$comment: Feature names this entry backs; their union is the glossary (ADR-0023). May be empty for a claim that backs no feature name.

items.description: must be a feature name without leading or trailing whitespace
